about:
I am a B.Sc. Computer Science graduate from Ton Duc Thang University, currently working as a Node.js Developer at KOOLA International Technology Solutions — building and maintaining production backends with Fastify 4, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, shipping a bilingual AI-powered website with Google Gemini + pgvector, and setting up Docker/CI-CD infrastructure.

On the AI side, I have hands-on experience in computer vision: face recognition with ArcFace, MediaPipe Face Mesh landmark detection, and a multi-stage anti-spoofing pipeline — alongside university-level study of Python, NumPy/Pandas, scikit-learn, and OpenCV.

I also bring 3+ years of teaching experience — independently leading coding classes for students aged 7–18 — which sharpened my communication, adaptability, and problem-solving skills. I am eager to grow in international, technically demanding environments.

bullets: Built and maintained the production backend for koola.vn using Fastify 4 + TypeScript, serving bilingual (Vi/EN) content with a full admin API secured by JWT access/refresh tokens.
Integrated Google Gemini API with pgvector semantic search on PostgreSQL to power an AI chat assistant — handling embedding generation, vector similarity queries, and streaming responses.
Designed raw-SQL repositories (no ORM) against PostgreSQL 16, authored migrations, and set up Prometheus health-check endpoints.
Containerised the entire stack (Fastify API + Next.js + Nginx + PostgreSQL) with Docker Compose and configured Cloudflare Tunnel for zero-trust ingress.
Shipped automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions: build, test, rsync deploy to VPS on every push to main.

Contributed face-attendance kiosk module to the company ERP: ArcFace recognition, MediaPipe Face Mesh landmark detection, and a multi-stage anti-spoofing pipeline (blink EAR + head-nod liveness + MiniFASNetV2).
Independently led coding classes for students aged 7–18, covering Scratch, Python, and Lua.
Took full responsibility as the main instructor for multiple classes, ensuring lesson delivery, student engagement, and classroom management.
Adapted teaching methods to different age groups and learning styles, developing students' logical thinking and foundational programming skills.
Monitored student progress, provided constructive feedback, and maintained communication with parents.
Assisted the lead teacher in designing and organizing effective lesson plans tailored to student needs.
Collaborated with instructors to identify learning challenges and proposed appropriate interventions.
Provided additional instruction to students requiring extra support to grasp key concepts.
Prepared teaching materials and set up necessary equipment before each class to ensure smooth lesson delivery.
Managed student attendance and maintained accurate records.
Assisted the lead teacher during lessons by supporting student engagement and reinforcing key concepts.

projects.name: ANBINHFOODS ERP — Intelligent Manufacturing Platform
projects.desc: Company ERP system built for An Binh Foods, a dried-fruit manufacturer, covering the full operations loop: quotation, purchasing, warehouse, vacuum-drying production, quality, finance, and HR. Three services: React 18 + Vite frontend, Express 5 + Prisma + PostgreSQL 16 backend (155 models, ~90 services), and a FastAPI AI service with RAG chatbot and ReAct agent. My contributions (50 commits): warehouse receipt/issue slip UI with print and Excel export, maintenance request (YCSC) workflow refactor, purchase request detail layout, plus test suites and CI workflow.

projects.name: koola.vn — Company Website
projects.desc: Production monorepo for KOOLA International Technology Solutions. Bilingual (Vi/EN) site with an AI chat assistant powered by Google Gemini and pgvector semantic search, a full admin panel, JWT auth, and automated CI/CD deployment to a self-hosted VPS via GitHub Actions + rsync.

projects.name: Koola Demo — Full-Stack Boilerplate
projects.desc: Full-stack starter built to validate the KOOLA architecture before production. Node.js/Express REST API with JWT authentication, MongoDB, and a Next.js 15 frontend. Containerised with Docker Compose for one-command local development.

projects.name: Traffic Sign Detection — Non-AI
projects.desc: University project demonstrating traffic sign detection using classical computer vision techniques — no deep learning. Combines colour-based segmentation and geometric shape analysis to locate and classify road signs, highlighting the contrast between traditional CV and modern neural approaches.

projects.name: ERP Face Attendance Kiosk
projects.desc: Face attendance kiosk module built inside a company ERP system. Implemented ArcFace-based face recognition with a multi-stage anti-spoofing pipeline: blink detection via Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR), head-nod liveness challenge, and passive liveness with MiniFASNetV2. Used MediaPipe Face Mesh for landmark detection and YuNet for robust face detection. Admin enrollment flow features Face ID–style auto-capture with pose validation.

projects.name: GimJi Restaurant Management
projects.desc: Team project building a restaurant management desktop app in C# WinForms with a clean 3-layer architecture. Responsible for the Order, Payment, and Login modules — including UI design, business logic, and data access layers.
